entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The historic Graf Manor lay on the..."
entries.dialogueText: The historic Graf Manor lay on the outskirts of Arvory, at the end of a long, winding drive. Nearly two centuries old, it was as formidable as Lileas herself.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas had invited me here for a pr..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas had invited me here for a private dinner, just the two of us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I wasn't sure of her motivations, b..."
entries.dialogueText: I wasn't sure of her motivations, but was happy to have an excuse to escape the chaos back in Holsord.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I wasn't sure of her motivations, b..."
entries.dialogueText: I wasn't sure of her motivations, but I was happy to have an excuse to escape the unbearable loneliness at home.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I wasn't sure of her motivations. I..."
entries.dialogueText: I wasn't sure of her motivations. I only hoped I wouldn't have to spend the night there.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge dropped me off at the door."
entries.dialogueText: Serge dropped me off at the door.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I used the heavy brass door knocker..."
entries.dialogueText: I used the heavy brass door knocker to signal my arrival. The butler answered and showed me into the parlor.
entries.menuText: Knock.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I cautiously pushed the heavy door..."
entries.dialogueText: I cautiously pushed the heavy door open. I followed the sound of classical music into the parlor.
entries.menuText: Go inside without knocking.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gas lanterns lent the wood-paneled..."
entries.dialogueText: Gas lanterns lent the wood-paneled room a cosy orange glow. Lileas was sitting on the sofa. Above her hung a nearly life-sized portrait of a sallow, unhappy-looking young woman in a lace ball gown.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Is that you?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is that you?"
entries.menuText: "Is that you?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Is that your mother?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is that your mother?"
entries.menuText: "Is that your mother?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Is that your grandmother?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is that your grandmother?"
entries.menuText: "Is that your grandmother?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas nodded.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""My mother, actually.""
entries.dialogueText: "My mother, actually."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""My mother, actually.""
entries.dialogueText: "My mother, actually."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I was her only child, you know. Gi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was her only child, you know. Giving birth to me left her medically unable to conceive."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""My father never could forgive her..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father never could forgive her for not bearing him a son. And she never forgave me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She took a measured sip of one of t..."
entries.dialogueText: She took a measured sip of one of the two glasses of sparkling wine she was holding, and handed me the other.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sounds like a painful childhood.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds like a painful childhood."
entries.menuText: "Sounds like a painful childhood."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Get to the point, Lileas. Why did..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get to the point, Lileas. Why did you invite me here?"
entries.menuText: "Get to the point, Lileas. Why did you invite me here?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Given your current circumstances w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given your current circumstances with Mrs. Rayne, I thought you could use a home-cooked supper."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: !(BaseGame.Relations_Monica_LeadsWomensRights == true && BaseGame.Bill_Turn09_StrongWomensRights_Vetoed == false || BaseGame.Bill_Turn09_WeakWomensRights_Vetoed == false)

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Given how your wife spends her tim..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given how your wife spends her time these days, I thought you might be in need of a home-cooked supper."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I couldn't let you go a full term..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't let you go a full term without having one of my home-cooked suppers."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The butler silently stepped into th..."
entries.dialogueText: The butler silently stepped into the parlor and rang a silver bell.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""The silver lining is that despite..."
entries.dialogueText: "The silver lining is that despite personally despising me, they felt compelled to grant me all the advantages a son would have had. Including the education I needed to rise to my current position."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Ah. Speaking of which.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ah. Speaking of which."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She led me into the dining room, wh..."
entries.dialogueText: She led me into the dining room, where a glittering chandelier hung from the high ceiling. Beneath it was a long table set for two. A woman in an apron and chef's hat, Wehzek by her appearance, ceremoniously presented a roast rack of venison.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Smells delicious.""
entries.dialogueText: "Smells delicious."
entries.menuText: "Smells delicious."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Nice story. Why am I here?""
entries.dialogueText: "Nice story. Why am I here?"
entries.menuText: "Nice story. Why am I here?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Would you be so kind as to tell me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Would you be so kind as to tell me why you invited me over?"
entries.menuText: "Would you be so kind as to tell me why you invited me over?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A home-cooked supper, huh?""
entries.dialogueText: "A home-cooked supper, huh?"
entries.menuText: "A home-cooked supper, huh?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Please, Mr. Rayne. I didn't get to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Mr. Rayne. I didn't get to where I am now by slaving away in the kitchen."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas bowed her head and said a qu..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas bowed her head and said a quick prayer, then motioned for me to dig in.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""The groundskeeper shot it this mor..."
entries.dialogueText: "The groundskeeper shot it this morning."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Anton, I want you to know that I h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anton, I want you to know that I have nothing but respect for you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks."
entries.menuText: "Thanks."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I respect you too.""
entries.dialogueText: "I respect you too."
entries.menuText: "I respect you too."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But?""
entries.dialogueText: "But?"
entries.menuText: "But?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""But, given certain developments th..."
entries.dialogueText: "But, given certain developments that have occurred over the course of your term, I believe you are no longer fit to lead the United Sordland Party."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I wanted you to be the first to kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wanted you to be the first to know that I myself will be running against you at the Party Congress."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I forbid you from doing that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I forbid you from doing that."
entries.menuText: "I forbid you from doing that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What the hell do you mean, unfit?""
entries.dialogueText: "What the hell do you mean, unfit?"
entries.menuText: "What the hell do you mean, unfit?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Are you going to pretend you're no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you going to pretend you're not currently on the verge of impeachment?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You're a disgrace to the memory of..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're a disgrace to the memory of Tarquin Soll. Whom, lest we forget, you killed."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You're a disgrace to the name of T..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're a disgrace to the name of Tarquin Soll. Whom, lest we forget, you threw into prison."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You're a disgrace to the name of T..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're a disgrace to the name of Tarquin Soll. Whom, lest we forget, you tried to have imprisoned."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I spat a mouthful of chewed-up veni..."
entries.dialogueText: I spat a mouthful of chewed-up venison across the table.
entries.menuText: Spit out your food in shock.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Did you think I'd sit by as you ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did you think I'd sit by as you made a mockery out of this country's constitution?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Did you think I'd sit by after you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did you think I'd sit by after you ignored our request to seize power from the Oligarchs?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You're a disgrace to the good name..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're a disgrace to the good name of Tarquin Soll."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas took a deep breath."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas took a deep breath.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I don't know why you're surprised.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know why you're surprised."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Don't play dumb with me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't play dumb with me."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""And who are you to give me orders?""
entries.dialogueText: "And who are you to give me orders?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Did you poison my food?""
entries.dialogueText: "Did you poison my food?"
entries.menuText: "Did you poison my food?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""It's a little late for that.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's a little late for that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're fired.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're fired."
entries.menuText: "You're fired."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How much money will it take for yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "How much money will it take for you to stay on my side?"
entries.menuText: "How much money will it take for you to stay on my side?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas gave a short laugh and gestu..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas gave a short laugh and gestured at our grand surroundings.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Do I look like I need money?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do I look like I need money?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas reached over to my plate, to..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas reached over to my plate, took a forkful of meat and ate it while looking me in the eye.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I don't need those kinds of tricks..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't need those kinds of tricks to beat you."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I'm doing you a courtesy tonight...."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm doing you a courtesy tonight. I didn't want to surprise you at the Congress."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""And I wanted to give you time to c..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I wanted to give you time to consider backing me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're mad.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're mad."
entries.menuText: "You're mad."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sorry, Lileas. I can't back down n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, Lileas. I can't back down now."
entries.menuText: "Sorry, Lileas. I can't back down now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I won't do it. And neither will th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't do it. And neither will the rest of the party."
entries.menuText: "I won't do it. And neither will the rest of the party."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""We'll see about that.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll see about that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled mysteriously."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled mysteriously.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""That's what they said about you, w..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's what they said about you, when you first went up against Alphonso."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I'll tender my official resignatio..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll tender my official resignation once we're both back in Holsord."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I rose from my chair."
entries.dialogueText: I rose from my chair.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's a shame to lose you.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's a shame to lose you."
entries.menuText: "It's a shame to lose you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""May the best man win, then.""
entries.dialogueText: "May the best man win, then."
entries.menuText: "May the best man win, then."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I understand now why you never fou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand now why you never found a husband."
entries.menuText: "I understand now why you never found a husband."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Likewise.""
entries.dialogueText: "Likewise."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I'll have the butler show you out.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll have the butler show you out."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stayed seated as her butler gen..."
entries.dialogueText: She stayed seated as her butler gently led me outside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As Serge and I drove away, I looked..."
entries.dialogueText: As Serge and I drove away, I looked in the rearview mirror and saw her silhouette in the doorway.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "So I was being challenged from with..."
entries.dialogueText: So I was being challenged from within my own party. At least Lileas wouldn't pose much of a threat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Or so I hoped."
entries.dialogueText: Or so I hoped.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Mr. President, I wish I had been c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I wish I had been consulted on this military parade decision. Is that really the best use of our time and resources given the mounting unrest in this country?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't worry. The military's taking..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. The military's taking care of it."
entries.menuText: "Don't worry. The military's taking care of it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Aren't your police taking care of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aren't your police taking care of it?"
entries.menuText: "Aren't your police taking care of it?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The police are taking care of it...."
entries.dialogueText: "The police are taking care of it. A little too well, I might add."
entries.menuText: "The police are taking care of it. A little too well, I might add."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The military's taking care of it...."
entries.dialogueText: "The military's taking care of it. A little too well, actually."
entries.menuText: "The military's taking care of it. A little too well, actually."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've got it all under control.""
entries.dialogueText: "I've got it all under control."
entries.menuText: "I've got it all under control."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I worked things out diplomatically..."
entries.dialogueText: "I worked things out diplomatically. Like I said I would."
entries.menuText: "I worked things out diplomatically. Like I said I would."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""For now. But now that you've shown..."
entries.dialogueText: "For now. But now that you've shown you're willing to negotiate, these people will never be happy."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You and I both know that's not tru..."
entries.dialogueText: "You and I both know that's not true. Your 'diplomacy' was a disaster."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""They'd be doing a lot better if yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "They'd be doing a lot better if you hadn't fired my best man."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You gave them authority to act wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "You gave them authority to act within Sordland's borders. Whatever they do is on your head."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You gave the orders. You can't bla..."
entries.dialogueText: "You gave the orders. You can't blame them for doing their job."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""That itself is cause for worry.""
entries.dialogueText: "That itself is cause for worry."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""They're doing their best. But Sord..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're doing their best. But Sordland is far from safe."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Mr. President, I'm worried the mou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I'm worried the mounting unrest might hurt our chances of re-election."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lies. All lies.""
entries.dialogueText: "Lies. All lies."
entries.menuText: "Lies. All lies."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Those scandal revelations about yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Those scandal revelations about you are circulating in the government circles and might soon spread further out..."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""The encroaching war with Rumburg c..."
entries.dialogueText: "The encroaching war with Rumburg certainly doesn't help matters."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll be just fine.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be just fine."
entries.menuText: "I'll be just fine."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What do you think I should do abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you think I should do about that?"
entries.menuText: "What do you think I should do about that?"

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I grabbed my fork."
entries.dialogueText: I grabbed my fork.
entries.menuText: Start eating.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Aren't you forgetting something?""
entries.dialogueText: "Aren't you forgetting something?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was some of the best meat I'd ev..."
entries.dialogueText: It was some of the best meat I'd ever had. We ate in silence for a while, then Lileas pensively laid down her cutlery.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I don't think the allegations will..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think the allegations will do much damage, but it's worth keeping an eye on."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""A strong leader would ignore the a..."
entries.dialogueText: "A strong leader would ignore the allegations and focus on winning the election. By all means necessary."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Don't be silly. Karl told me every..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be silly. Karl told me everything."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I'm sure they are.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure they are."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Anton, thank you for all the help..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anton, thank you for all the help you've given to my ministry during your term."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You followed through on your campa..."
entries.dialogueText: "You followed through on your campaign promises, and Sordland is stronger and safer for it."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I'm all the more grateful consider..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm all the more grateful considering it wasn't even initially a priority of yours."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Anton, I wish you had made nationa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anton, I wish you had made national security more of a top priority during your term."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Especially considering you were vo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially considering you were voted in on your promise to focus on it."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""But I was thrilled when you recogn..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I was thrilled when you recognized Sordish schools' right to religious expression over Ms. Walda's ridiculous objections."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""And I regret that you caved to Ms...."
entries.dialogueText: "And I regret that you caved to Ms. Walda and mandated the teaching of that evolution nonsense in schools."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""In any event, I'm looking forward..."
entries.dialogueText: "In any event, I'm looking forward to working more closely together during your next term."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Regardless, I'm looking forward to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Regardless, I'm looking forward to working more closely together during your next term."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I was thrilled when you recognized..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was thrilled when you recognized Sordish schools' right to religious expression over Ms. Walda's ridiculous objections."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I do regret that you caved to Ms...."
entries.dialogueText: "I do regret that you caved to Ms. Walda and mandated the teaching of that evolution nonsense in schools."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Karl deserved it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Karl deserved it."
entries.menuText: "Karl deserved it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sorry about that. I had to make an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry about that. I had to make an example out of him."
entries.menuText: "Sorry about that. I had to make an example out of him."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""As long as you can call off your d..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as you can call off your dogs when the time comes."
entries.menuText: "As long as you can call off your dogs when the time comes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""As long as the threats are neutral..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as the threats are neutralized."
entries.menuText: "As long as the threats are neutralized."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If Iosef turns against me, that co..."
entries.dialogueText: "If Iosef turns against me, that could mean trouble for all of us."
entries.menuText: "If Iosef turns against me, that could mean trouble for all of us."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""As long as Iosef is still on my si..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as Iosef is still on my side, they won't get out of hand."
entries.menuText: "As long as Iosef is still on my side, they won't get out of hand."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I know what you think I should've..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know what you think I should've done. But the police would only make a mess of things."
entries.menuText: "I know what you think I should've done. But the police would only make a mess of things."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What would you have me do, shoot t..."
entries.dialogueText: "What would you have me do, shoot the lot of them?"
entries.menuText: "What would you have me do, shoot the lot of them?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas pursed her lips."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas pursed her lips.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I don't think the allegations will..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think the allegations will do much damage, especially with your opposition so weakened. But it's worth keeping an eye on."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks for everything you've done,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for everything you've done, Lileas."
entries.menuText: "Thanks for everything you've done, Lileas."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't worry about me. Focus on doi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry about me. Focus on doing your job."
entries.menuText: "Don't worry about me. Focus on doing your job."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas nodded.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Me too, if it means more excellent..."
entries.dialogueText: "Me too, if it means more excellent dinners like this."
entries.menuText: "Me too, if it means more excellent dinners like this."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""And placing the Gendarmerie under..."
entries.dialogueText: "And placing the Gendarmerie under my jurisdiction was above and beyond my highest expectations."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I do wish you had heeded my reques..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do wish you had heeded my request to place the Gendarmerie under my jurisdiction."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""But I'm pleased you at least recog..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I'm pleased you at least recognized the need to place the Gendarmerie under my jurisdiction."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Likewise, I wish you had heeded my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Likewise, I wish you had heeded my request to place the Gendarmerie under my jurisdiction."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Not to mention feeling the need to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to mention feeling the need to pump our children full of strange chemicals in response to some unconfirmed health threat."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""However, I'm grateful you defended..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, I'm grateful you defended Sordish citizens' right not to subject their children to mandatory vaccinations."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Likewise, I'm grateful you defende..."
entries.dialogueText: "Likewise, I'm grateful you defended Sordish citizens' right not to subject their children to mandatory vaccinations."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I was less enthused about your dec..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was less enthused about your decision to pump our children full of strange chemicals in response to some unconfirmed health threat."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll drink to that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll drink to that."
entries.menuText: "I'll drink to that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""God willing.""
entries.dialogueText: "God willing."
entries.menuText: "God willing."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We clinked glasses."
entries.dialogueText: We clinked glasses.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas raised her glass and smiled."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas raised her glass and smiled.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas' upper lip twitched, but she..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas' upper lip twitched, but she remained calm.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""How are you feeling about that, ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "How are you feeling about that, may I ask?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""How are you feeling about the encr..."
entries.dialogueText: "How are you feeling about the encroaching war with Rumburg?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Great. We'll show those snobs who'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Great. We'll show those snobs who's boss."
entries.menuText: "Great. We'll show those snobs who's boss."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Not terrific, to be honest. I didn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not terrific, to be honest. I didn't want a war during my presidency."
entries.menuText: "Not terrific, to be honest. I didn't want a war during my presidency."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How are you feeling about it?""
entries.dialogueText: "How are you feeling about it?"
entries.menuText: "How are you feeling about it?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Nobody does, dear.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody does, dear."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I'm glad you're feeling positive.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad you're feeling positive."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""From a national security perspecti..."
entries.dialogueText: "From a national security perspective, quite good. We've managed to keep a lid on any potential intelligence leaks."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""From a national security perspecti..."
entries.dialogueText: "From a national security perspective, I think we're in good shape. We've managed to keep a lid on any potential intelligence leaks."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""To be honest, I'm a little worried..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be honest, I'm a little worried. Our national security's still shaky. There may be information leaking to Rumburg from within the Maroon Palace."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I'm a little worried myself. Our n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm a little worried myself. Our national security's still shaky. There may be information leaking to Rumburg from within the Maroon Palace."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Since imprisoning my ex-secretary,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Since imprisoning my ex-secretary, you mean."
entries.menuText: "Since imprisoning my ex-secretary, you mean."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If only the other ministries were..."
entries.dialogueText: "If only the other ministries were as prepared as yours."
entries.menuText: "If only the other ministries were as prepared as yours."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So Livia was acting alone.""
entries.dialogueText: "So Livia was acting alone."
entries.menuText: "So Livia was acting alone."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Keep up the good work.""
entries.dialogueText: "Keep up the good work."
entries.menuText: "Keep up the good work."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm sure you'll find the source.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure you'll find the source."
entries.menuText: "I'm sure you'll find the source."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Maybe Lucian was right about Livia.""
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe Lucian was right about Livia."
entries.menuText: "Maybe Lucian was right about Livia."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Exactly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""It appears so.""
entries.dialogueText: "It appears so."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Thank you for your vote of confide..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your vote of confidence."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Maybe?""
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Never mind.""
entries.dialogueText: "Never mind."
entries.menuText: "Never mind."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We'll talk about that later.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll talk about that later."
entries.menuText: "We'll talk about that later."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas paused. She fixed me with a..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas paused. She fixed me with a piercing look.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Remember, war requires sacrifices...."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember, war requires sacrifices. I hope you're ready to do what it takes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia frowned, then looked up and l..."
entries.dialogueText: Livia frowned, then looked up and looked me straight in the eye.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Especially with dear Franc in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially with dear Franc in the military."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Franc wants to fight. He'll do any..."
entries.dialogueText: "Franc wants to fight. He'll do anything for this country."
entries.menuText: "Franc wants to fight. He'll do anything for this country."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm not sending Franc to the front..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not sending Franc to the front lines."
entries.menuText: "I'm not sending Franc to the front lines."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Franc would be useless in a war.""
entries.dialogueText: "Franc would be useless in a war."
entries.menuText: "Franc would be useless in a war."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""That's good to hear. I think back..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's good to hear. I think back so fondly on my own military days."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Come, now. Give the boy a chance t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come, now. Give the boy a chance to do his country and his father proud."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Of course I am.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course I am."
entries.menuText: "Of course I am."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We'll win this without having to s..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll win this without having to sacrifice a damn thing."
entries.menuText: "We'll win this without having to sacrifice a damn thing."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Good.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Language!""
entries.dialogueText: "Language!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We ate silently for a little while..."
entries.dialogueText: We ate silently for a little while longer, then Lileas spoke up again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "By the end of the meal, I was pleas..."
entries.dialogueText: By the end of the meal, I was pleasantly full and a little tipsy. The butler had to lead me back through the manor's winding corridors until I found the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I waved at Lileas out the window as..."
entries.dialogueText: I waved at Lileas out the window as Serge pulled away. The coming campaign would be turbulent, but at least I had her on my side.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Did you think I liked it when you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did you think I liked it when you refused to tighten Sordland's borders against disreputable migrants?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Was I really going to ignore your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Was I really going to ignore your foolish refusal to re-instate conscription?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Even if you weren't steering this..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if you weren't steering this party further and further from its roots..."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Even if you hadn't unceremoniously..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if you hadn't unceremoniously deposed honorable Supreme Court justices to suit your own perverse purposes..."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Just stay true to your promise to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just stay true to your promise to honor our party's conservative roots, and the good Lord will take care of the rest."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Enough of this. Lileas, I know abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough of this. Lileas, I know about your role in the Bernard Circas murder."
entries.menuText: "Enough of this. Lileas, I know about your role in the Bernard Circas murder."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas calmly sipped her wine."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas calmly sipped her wine.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I'm sure I have no idea what you'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure I have no idea what you're talking about."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No? Maybe you should ask Orso Hawk..."
entries.dialogueText: "No? Maybe you should ask Orso Hawker. He's being held over at the Justice Ministry right now."
entries.menuText: "No? Maybe you should ask Orso Hawker. He's being held over at the Justice Ministry right now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No? Maybe you should ask Orso Hawk..."
entries.dialogueText: "No? Maybe you should ask Orso Hawker and Heron Garaci. They're being held over at the Justice Ministry right now."
entries.menuText: "No? Maybe you should ask Orso Hawker and Heron Garaci. They're being held over at the Justice Ministry right now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Maybe you should ask half of the d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe you should ask half of the deep state that was purged. I only spared you because you're more valuable on my side."
entries.menuText: "Maybe you should ask half of the deep state that was purged. I only spared you because you're more valuable on my side."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas' face hardened."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas' face hardened.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""What do you want, Anton?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you want, Anton?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""For you not to run against me, obv..."
entries.dialogueText: "For you not to run against me, obviously. You'll join me on the campaign trail. Enthusiastically."
entries.menuText: "For you not to run against me, obviously. You'll join me on the campaign trail. Enthusiastically."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Well, now that I know you've been..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, now that I know you've been planning to betray me, I want to see you brought to justice. I'm ordering your arrest tomorrow."
entries.menuText: "Well, now that I know you've been planning to betray me, I want to see you brought to justice. I'm ordering your arrest tomorrow."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas grimaced."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas grimaced.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Very well, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas glared at me."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas glared at me.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Now get out of my house.""
entries.dialogueText: "Now get out of my house."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Get out of my house.""
entries.dialogueText: "Get out of my house."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks for dinner.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for dinner."
entries.menuText: "Thanks for dinner."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""With pleasure.""
entries.dialogueText: "With pleasure."
entries.menuText: "With pleasure."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without waiting for the butler to s..."
entries.dialogueText: Without waiting for the butler to show me out, I rose from my seat and made my way to the front door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She would make a formidable enemy...."
entries.dialogueText: She would make a formidable enemy. I was happy to have corralled her to my side.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As Serge and I drove away, I looked..."
entries.dialogueText: As Serge and I drove away, I looked in the rear-view mirror and saw her silhouette in the doorway.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For now, at least."
entries.dialogueText: For now, at least.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She would make a formidable enemy...."
entries.dialogueText: She would make a formidable enemy. Thanks to my investigation, I'd managed to dodge that bullet.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's over Lileas and you know it...."
entries.dialogueText: "It's over Lileas and you know it. There is no need to make it worse."
entries.menuText: "It's over Lileas and you know it. There is no need to make it worse."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Our borders were open to an influx..."
